title: Audit all resolved known issues with verification evidence and exclude vendor noise from graphify

Audited all 33 marked-Resolved known issues against source code and automated tests (183 tests passing).\n3. Uncovered fake/partial resolutions: ISSUE-024 claimed queue resume fixed, but left blocked_quota_types stuck in memory spawning ISSUE-035; ISSUE-008 left progress percent denominator containing skipped jobs spawning ISSUE-036; 6 frontend UI issues (018, 022, 026, 029, 031, 032) lack automated regression tests relying only on manual notes.
todo_items: Enforce automated test coverage for the 6 unverified UI issues via TASK-017 chaos suite, and resolve the root causes of the pseudo-fixes via TASK-014, TASK-015, and TASK-016.
